timeline.text: Welcome to Before Asking for a Raise. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I feel nervous about asking for a raise.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I am afraid the answer will be no.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me worries I will seem demanding.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep questioning whether I have earned this conversation.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is bracing for an uncomfortable response.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I feel pressure to say everything perfectly.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am imagining how they might judge me.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that advocating for myself feels vulnerable.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This conversation feels bigger than it needs to be.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can ask without controlling the answer.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: A professional request is not a personal demand.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can speak from facts instead of fear.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: My contribution is worth discussing clearly.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can settle before the conversation begins.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I do not need a perfect script to communicate well.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can listen without abandoning my position.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: A no would be information, not a verdict on my worth.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can make room for a respectful conversation.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am ready to speak clearly about my value.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can name my contributions with confidence.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to make a direct request.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can stay present while they respond.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel steady and open.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am allowed to advocate for fair recognition.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can ask useful follow-up questions.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I will respect myself regardless of the immediate answer.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to begin this conversation.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
